name: Planned integrated public transport network (PMA IPTN)
name_ur: فیصل آباد منصوبہ بند فیڈر نیٹ ورک (پی ایم اے)

sources.title: Integrated Public Transport Network Faisalabad (file name: Faisalabad Integrated Feeder Routes)
Master Plan Faisalabad 2021-2041, Transportation Report, section 5.1 and Figs 5-1/5-2 (pp. 5-55 to 5-57)
sources.publisher: Faisalabad Development Authority (consultants Osmani & Co., Prof. S.N. Pollalis)

notes: 35-route PMA planning network (undated PDF, c.2017-2019) in 5 phases: 16 mini-bus feeders (Ph I-II), 9 feeders (Ph III), 4 express (Ph IV), 6 sub-urban (Ph V); total 568.5 km, 459 buses. Headway is not printed (round-trip time and bus count are). Same format as lahore-iptn-planned / multan-iptn-planned. Different from the Faisalabad Metrobus Red/Orange feeder networks in the FDA Master Plan (43 + 41 routes, summary tables only).
